headline: Vivo Energy Uganda and MTN Offer Fuel Cashback Promotion
summary: Vivo Energy Uganda and MTN Mobile Money are offering motorists a 20% cashback on qualifying fuel purchases at participating Shell stations during weekday hours.
why: Promotional partnerships between fuel retailers and mobile money operators drive digital transaction adoption and consumer volume.

impacts.name: MTN Group
impacts.why: Cashback promotions increase mobile money transaction volumes.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
